purpose: Versioned, evidence-backed mapping from registered components and their declared consumers to repository test targets for R/O/G pull-request validation.
claim_ceiling: This map selects repository validation only. It does not establish real-world causal effects, grant execution or publication authority, or replace required shared security, permission, evidence, review, or release checks.

Existing current-state sync, surface compilation and state-change tests exercise the affected declared consumers.
Existing epistemic relationship, ESI human-surface, soft-governance authority, and durability tests exercise the declared G boundary consumers without granting truth or permission authority.
Existing federation contract, ownership, and adversarial tests exercise the declared executor and future-slot permission, interface, and evidence boundaries.

Existing Foundation claim-governance and nonfunction-closure consumers validate L3 argument and claim relationships.
A focused test validates the existing historical rights-remediation register against its schema and reconciles its declared summary from the register entries without rewriting historical records.
These existing tests cover the registered no-L7 and system-map/front-door projection constraints.
These test modules are the existing registered consumers of Ignition Operating Method and its run-mode, capability, lifecycle, output and stranger-agent boundaries.
These existing publication and synchronization consumer tests cover L6/iteration publication constraints.
These existing consumers validate Foundation path classification and the propagation/era-resolution contracts affected by the L5 classification source.
Existing human-result and knowledge-experience validators and tests cover the registered human_knowledge_surfaces outputs and their derived consumers.
